title: JSON Patch (RFC 6902)
description: A JSON Patch document as defined by RFC 6902, referenced by STATE_DELTA.delta and ACTIVITY_DELTA.patch. Kept in its own file because it is an external standard rather than an AG-UI definition: a reader can check it against RFC 6902 instead of against AG-UI prose.

JsonPatch.description: An ordered sequence of operations applied to a target document. An empty array is a valid no-op patch. Whether the operations actually apply to the document they target is a runtime question RFC 6902 leaves to the applier; structural validity here says nothing about it.

JsonPatchOperation.description: A single RFC 6902 operation. Exactly one of the six operation shapes must match, discriminated by op. Members that the operation does not define are deliberately permitted: RFC 6902 section 4 requires them to be ignored rather than rejected, so a remove carrying a leftover value is a valid patch. Two of the RFC's rules are relations between values rather than shapes, so no static schema can express them and neither is checked here: a move whose from is a proper prefix of its path (section 4.4), and any operation whose pointer does not resolve in the target document. Both are the applier's to reject.

AddOperation.description: Inserts value at path. RFC 6902 section 4.1.

value.description: The value to insert. Any JSON value, including null, which is a legitimate thing to add.

RemoveOperation.description: Removes the value at path. RFC 6902 section 4.2.

ReplaceOperation.description: Replaces the value at path. RFC 6902 section 4.3.

value.description: The replacement. Any JSON value, including null.

MoveOperation.description: Moves the value at from to path. RFC 6902 section 4.4.

from.description: Where the value is moved from.

path.description: Where the value is moved to.

CopyOperation.description: Copies the value at from to path. RFC 6902 section 4.5.

from.description: Where the value is copied from.

path.description: Where the value is copied to.

TestOperation.description: Asserts that the value at path equals value. RFC 6902 section 4.6.

value.description: The value the target must equal. Any JSON value, including null.

JsonPointer.description: A JSON Pointer as defined by RFC 6901. Either the empty string, meaning the whole document, or a sequence of slash-prefixed reference tokens in which a tilde is escaped as ~0 and a slash as ~1. A value with no leading slash, or a tilde followed by anything other than 0 or 1, is not a JSON Pointer.
